music_ducking_user_report: root cause found and fixed 2026-09-09: plugin/music-effects.js called getParamCount()/getParam() directly on the component returned by AudioFilterFactory.createComponentByDisplayName(), which is a bare AudioFilterComponent handle with neither method until it is actually appended into the clip's AudioComponentChain (matches the live error 'component.getParamCount is not a function', and Adobe's own type declarations document AudioFilterComponent as having zero methods vs. Component -- returned by AudioComponentChain.getComponentAtIndex() -- which does). Fixed by splitting prepare() into createComponent() (factory call only), installed() (re-fetch from the chain after the append transaction commits) and configure() (reads/builds keyframes on the now-installed Component); call sites in music-pass.js now run two transactions (append effect, then commit keyframes) instead of one. Mocks in tests/music-pass.test.cjs previously gave the factory-created handle full methods immediately (an idealized/incorrect shape) and could not have caught this; mocks now model the same handle/installed split, plus a new explicit regression test. Real-Premiere confirmation from the user is still needed.
